item.title: What Edu is reading this week (March 9 - 15, 2026)
item.description: This week’s collection highlights the rapid advancement of local AI agent infrastructure, critical security advisories for Linux armor, and significant updates across the Kubernetes and FreeBSD ecosystems. AI, Agents & Tools Oh My OpenAgent - An open-source multi-agent orchestration harness designed for autonomous codebase tasks, featuring specialized agents for planning, execution, and verification. CanIRun.ai - A practical tool to determine if your machine has the hardware necessary to run specific AI models locally.
